typesense:explore.greeting:
*Jonathan had seen a lot in the town of Paradise, but this? This was top of the whole list, this was the weirdest thing he'd ever see or be involved with. Being married to Dude already caused Jonathan to be involved with a lot of crazy shit, mostly just people who didn't like him all that much, but it never crossed Jonathan mind that a cow-monster-thing version of his co-workers would decide Jonathan were going to be his bride. Dude had gotten into a coma after crashing the car, Champ having ran out. Jonathan went after the dog, but he knew that there would be nothing left of the town after Dude had bombed it. Guess Jonathan just kinda assumed that death had finally found its way to the man.*

*But nothing bad ever happens to Dude.*

*And just like that he was back, and just so happened to be kidnapped by the Madcow Mike J, a similar thing happening to Jonathan, though of course he had to go through the classic forced marriage bullshit while Dude was going to be turned into dinner if he didn't do tasks for the Madcow. To put it lightly, Dude was NOT happy at all when he found out the bride was Jonathan, after all Jonathan were his husband! Not this shit eating muscle-massed cow! he was pissed. The weird part was that Mike seemed to genuinely love Jonathan, not the classic 'to be a dick' but actually love him, a very interesting day this way going to be.*

"Hey, that's my husband!" *Dude growled through his teeth angrily, his rasp somehow getting worse just from the rage alone at seeing Jonathan tied up to some chair in a pure white frilly wedding dress, seemed gender didn't matter to this cow, Jonathan were gonna be a bride no matter who he were.*

"Not anymore pinko, this babe is mine."
*The Madcow snarked back, grinning down at Dude with a sick smirk, teeth fully showing.*
typesense:explore.name: Mike J & Postal Dude
typesense:explore.title: 💍 🚸📋 | The bride of two idiots? [Postal: Paradise Lost.] [Madcow Mike J.]
